changes.note: Incident files are 05_other_sources/911/cad_incidents_YYYY-MM.csv (matches the glob). PSAP reports and ALI subscriber records are in 05_other_sources/911/reports/*.csv, outside the glob so the geo rule for 911 positions is not applied to tables without coordinates. Suggested extra glob: 05_other_sources/911/reports/*.csv.

Aerial collection index is in 05_other_sources/infrastructure/aerial_survey/collection_index.csv (no coordinates, so kept out of the infrastructure/*.csv geo rule). utility_site_survey.csv is in the main folder with LATITUDE/LONGITUDE of the asset.
Folder also holds shelter_211_calls.csv and evacuation_bus_trips.csv.
Folder also holds sar_asset_log.csv, flood_depth_soundings.csv, flood_extent_snapshots.csv. Key time column of sar_missions.csv is launch_utc; one row per rescue case, mission_id groups a sortie.
ids_from_registry in the catalogue names entity_registry.json; the export's ids are the public-record fact ids plus three NOTICE-* records.
Cadence differs from the catalogue text (see schemas/avl_schema.json) to keep the stream under the size limit.
